linked_prs.title: 🐛 fix: pass threadId to messages in sendMessageInServer
linked_prs.body:
## Summary

- Add `threadId` parameter to `CreateMessageParams` interface
- Pass `threadId` when creating user and assistant messages in `aiChat` router
- Add comprehensive tests for `threadId` handling and `outputJSON` method

This fix ensures thread context is properly maintained across message creation, resolving the recent thread-related issues.

- fix https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/9351

This PR also addresses the following related issues:

- Fixes #9628 - Messages in topic branches were being switched back to main topic because threadId wasn't being passed when creating messages
- fix https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/issues/6396

All these issues stem from the same root cause: the `threadId` parameter was not being passed when creating user and assistant messages in the `sendMessageInServer` method. This PR ensures thread/branch context is properly maintained.

## Test plan

- [x] Added tests for `threadId` propagation to both user and assistant messages
- [x] Added tests for `outputJSON` method including error cases
- [x] All tests passing

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Summary by Sourcery

Ensure thread context is maintained by including threadId in aiChat message creation, enhance DevPanel to dynamic-load FloatPanel, and add comprehensive tests for threadId handling and the outputJSON method.

Bug Fixes:
- Pass threadId parameter when creating user and assistant messages in sendMessageInServer to maintain thread context

Enhancements:
- Add optional threadId field to CreateMessageParams interface
- Dynamically import FloatPanel component in DevPanel to disable server-side rendering

Tests:
- Add tests for threadId propagation in aiChatRouter
- Add tests for outputJSON covering successful generation, error handling, and tools support
